name: at eases back after a sustained backward move is accepted

steps.why: First fix is about 300 m along the open route.
This fix is about 200 m, 100 m behind; the first large backward fix is held.
This second large backward fix is about 180 m and confirms the reversal.
The accepted drawing eases linearly from 300 m to 180 m over 2 s; halfway through it is 240 m.
After the documented 2 s backward ease, drawing reaches the accepted 180 m fix.
